title: Railroad Tracks: Do Not Enter Without a Clear Exit
short: You need to cross the tracks.
section: Section 7 continued · Near Railroad or Light Rail Tracks
intro: There is no room for your car beyond the tracks. The crossing lights begin flashing.
watchCaption: The queue leaves no space beyond the tracks. Warning active.
safeCaption: You wait clear of the tracks while the train passes.
unsafeCaption: Your car cannot fit beyond the tracks. Wait before the gate.
safeFeedback: You wait behind the line. Cross only after the warning ends and there is room beyond the tracks.

feedback.queue-on-tracks: Following the queue left your car on the tracks. Wait until your whole car can fit on the far side.
feedback.bypass-gate: The warning was already active. Crossing before the gate closes puts you in the train’s path.
